requirements-traced-to-components.reason: RESTORED 2026-08-27. Every ACTIVE requirement traces to an ACTIVE component. Measured on the live project rather than asserted: 20 active requirements, 20 active components, no requirement untraced and none traced only by a retired component. REQ-0015 is `retired` and is correctly out of scope. ⚠️ THE APPLICATION SHELL IS WHAT CHANGED. REQ-0016 through REQ-0021 now trace through CMP-0012 (planning-content reader), CMP-0013 (restricted MDX compiler), CMP-0014 (server adapter layer), CMP-0015 (project view), CMP-0016 (stage view), CMP-0017 (change stream), CMP-0018 (review action), CMP-0019 (import-boundary check) and CMP-0020 (launcher). Each was designed against a constraint that had already been decided and measured — DEC-0018 through DEC-0023 — rather than against an unanswered question, which is the ordering the regression on 2026-08-24 existed to protect. ⚠️ ALL NINE ARE PLANNED, NOT BUILT. `implementedBy` is ABSENT on CMP-0012..CMP-0020, and that absence is the only signal in the artifacts which says so. This attestation therefore says exactly one thing: the trace edges exist and resolve. It does NOT say the application shell exists, works, or has been judged against anything. ⚠️ QST-0015's HAZARD IS LIVE AGAIN AND IS NAMED HERE RATHER THAN REDISCOVERED. The orphan check counts EDGES, so authoring these nine records took the orphan count to zero in one commit while no application code exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' is now true; 'the shell works' is not, and nothing mechanical distinguishes them at this stage. CMP-0011 hit the same hazard in 2026-08-22 and it was carried by an attestation then too — what makes it mechanical is acceptance criteria, which is stage 7's job and is where this work goes next. ⚠️ REGRESSES if a new requirement is authored without a component, if a component is retired while a requirement still depends on it, or if any of CMP-0012..CMP-0020 is deleted rather than implemented. It does NOT regress on implementation progress: this criterion is about the design tracing, and a criterion stretched to cover whether code exists would block stage 5 on stage 8's work.
